title: React 16 Fiber Scheduler Min-Heap Sift-Up (push / siftUp)
english_prompt: Write a JavaScript function `push(heap, node)` that inserts a task `node` (object with a numerical `sortIndex` and `id`) into a min-heap array `heap` and sifts it up to maintain the min-heap invariant. When `sortIndex` values are equal, use the lower `id` as the tie-breaker.

title: React 16 Shallow Property Comparator (shallowEqual)
english_prompt: Write a JavaScript function `shallowEqual(objA, objB)` that checks if two objects `objA` and `objB` are shallowly equal. Use `Object.is` for value comparisons, verify matching keys count, and ensure every key in `objA` exists in `objB` with identical value.

title: Go 1.10 strings.Builder String Concatenation (WriteString)
source_project: Go Standard Library (Russ Cox / Brad Fitzpatrick)
english_prompt: Write a Go method `(b *Builder) WriteString(s string) (int, error)` on a struct `Builder` (wrapping a `buf []byte` slice) that appends string `s` to the internal buffer byte slice `b.buf` and returns the number of bytes written `len(s)` along with a `nil` error.

title: Rust In-Place Slice Rotation Algorithm (rotate_left)
english_prompt: Write a Rust function `rotate_left<T>(slice: &mut [T], mid: usize)` that rotates the slice in-place so that the element at index `mid` becomes the first element. Assert `mid <= slice.len()`. If `mid == 0` or `mid == slice.len()`, return immediately. Use three block reversals (`slice[..mid].reverse()`, `slice[mid..].reverse()`, `slice.reverse()`).

title: PyTorch 1.0 Tensor Clamp Operator (clamp_out)
english_prompt: Write a C++ function `clamp_out(const double* self, double* result, size_t n, double min_val, double max_val)` that iterates over `n` double floating point elements in array `self` and writes the clamped value `std::min(std::max(x, min_val), max_val)` to array `result`.

title: Redis 5.0 Streams Radix Tree Insert (raxInsert)
english_prompt: Write a C function `rax_find_child(raxNode *n, unsigned char c)` that searches child character nodes of radix tree node `n` (having `n->numchildren` children in byte array `n->data`) for character `c`. If found, return index `i`, otherwise return -1.

title: TypeScript 3.0 Lexical Scanner Identifier Checker (isIdentifierStart)
english_prompt: Write a TypeScript function `isIdentifierStart(ch: number)` that checks if character code `ch` can start an identifier in JavaScript/TypeScript. Allow ASCII letters (`'A'`..`'Z'`, `'a'`..`'z'`), underscore `'_'` (0x5F), dollar sign `'$'` (0x24), and Unicode characters >= 0x7F.
human_pre_ai_code:
function isIdentifierStart(ch: number): boolean {
    return (ch >= 0x61 && ch <= 0x7A) || // a-z
           (ch >= 0x41 && ch <= 0x5A) || // A-Z
           ch === 0x24 ||                // $
           ch === 0x5F ||                // _
           ch >= 0x7F;                   // Unicode
}

title: Linux Kernel 4.14 eBPF Hashtable Bucket Lookup (htab_map_lookup_elem)
english_prompt: Write a C function `htab_map_lookup_elem(struct htab_bucket *b, uint32_t hash, const void *key, size_t key_size)` that iterates over the singly-linked collision chain `struct htab_elem *elem` in bucket `b->head`. Compare each element's cached `elem->hash == hash` and `memcmp(elem->key, key, key_size) == 0`. Return matching `elem`, or NULL if not found.

title: FastHTTP Case-Insensitive Header Comparison (caseInsensitiveCompare)
english_prompt: Write a Go function `caseInsensitiveCompare(a, b []byte) bool` that compares two byte slices `a` and `b` case-insensitively for equality. If lengths differ, return false immediately. Normalize uppercase ASCII characters `'A'..'Z'` to lowercase during comparison.

title: Rust Vec In-Place Predicate Filtering (Vec::retain)
english_prompt: Write a Rust method `retain<T, F>(&mut self, mut f: F)` for a `Vec<T>` struct (wrapping `len` and pointer/slice) that retains only the elements specified by predicate `f(&T) -> bool`. It filters elements in-place by scanning from index 0, shifting retained elements to fill gaps, and dropping deleted elements.
